$comment: Shared Claude Code settings for the issue-automation workflows
(issue-triage.yml, issue-autofix.yml, feature-shaping.yml). These run on a
PERSISTENT self-hosted runner with input from a public issue tracker, so the
agent's home directory is in reach of anything an issue body talks it into.
The read denials stop credential exfiltration: the triage workflow publishes
the agent's output verbatim to a public issue, so anything readable is
potentially publishable. The write denials stop persistence: $HOME survives
between runs (actions/checkout only cleans the workspace), so a file written
here would still be there for the NEXT claude invocation on this machine.
Treat this as defense in depth, not a boundary. The real boundaries are the
--allowed-tools list, the human approval gate on the write-capable workflows,
and the path denylist enforced on the diff before anything is committed.
